name: Aloo Keema
description: Pakistani aloo keema with beef mince, tender potatoes, tomatoes, green chilies and everyday spices for an easy family meal.
method: Heat oil and fry cumin seeds and onion until lightly golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and beef mince, then cook until the mince changes colour and moisture reduces.
Add tomatoes, green chilies and powdered spices and cook until the masala becomes glossy.
Add potatoes with a small splash of water, cover and cook until tender.
Remove the lid and cook until the gravy reaches your preferred consistency.
Finish with garam masala and fresh coriander and serve with roti or naan.
